thread:
ci-cd-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary failure detected for service `redwood-api` in prod (us-west-2). 5xx rate up from 0.6% -> 12% over 3m. Deployed image tag `release-2026-03-15` appears to have a mismatched digest during rollout. Auto-canary terminated. (run: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345)

alex: acked. paging oncall. i'm checking logs now. anyone seeing errors in other regions?

maria: i see increased latency spikes in eu-west as well, not as bad but trending. can we get a quick slice: which manifest was pushed?

ci-cd-bot: Push metadata: manifest_id=build-7890, image=registry.redwood.io/redwood/api:release-2026-03-15 -> expected_digest=sha256:11112222 got_digest=sha256:deadbeef (api checks failed).

jasper: who published that tag? sounds like a retag/regression in the registry (mutable tag got repointed). If true, we should kill traffic to that image and rollback to the last known-good digest.

alex: agreed. immediate plan: 1) flip feature flag for `prompt_cache_v2` to OFF (it was part of this deploy) 2) rollback deployment to digest sha256:11112222 3) disable canary rollout and force old image while we investigate registry. who can flip the flag?

maria: i can take the flag. olivia-cs — heads up to CS: potential customer impact while we flip.

olivia-cs: copying CS1 and the oncall rotation. I'll prepare a short customer note if this is >5% errors for top customers. pls ping me after rollback.

alex: maria, flag toggle steps:
```bash
# Using flags API
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"prompt_cache_v2","enabled":false,"reason":"rollback - canary failures"}'
```
Please confirm when done.

maria: done. flag is OFF. verified via UI.

sre-bot: Incident note: feature flag `prompt_cache_v2` -> disabled by maria at 2468135865.

alex: ok starting rollback. running safe rollback to digest 11112222 now:
```bash
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/redwood-api \
  redwood-api=registry.redwood.io/redwood/api@sha256:11112222 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/redwood-api --timeout=5m\```

jasper: quick check: we should also add an admission deny for pulling `release-2026-03-15` tag until registry is validated. if the tag is mutable we'll get the same again.

maria: rollback started. current rollout progress: 3/5 pods updated, new pods passing readiness checks.

ci-cd-bot: Registry scan: recent pushes to `release-2026-03-15` from CI runner `ci-worker-17` at 2468135720. Last two digests differ. Possible mutable tag overwrite.

alex: good catch. jasper can you put a short rego policy to deny mutable tag pulls? If not quick, at least remove tag from the index or set tag immutability.

jasper: putting a temporary deny via registry ACL and opening a ticket: `REG-4567`. Command (registry admin):
```bash
# block tag ref by removing write perms for ci-worker-17
registryctl acl deny --tag release-2026-03-15 --actor ci-worker-17
```
I've applied the ACL deny; registry should reject further retags.

maria: rollback completed. rollout status OK. pods at desired revision (digest sha256:11112222). health checks green. 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.

alex: monitoring: 5xx -> 2.1% now. still above baseline but trending down. olivia, any customers reporting?

olivia-cs: initial triage: 7 accounts saw elevated error rates (top 3 by volume: acme, parcel-n, paperbox). i'm drafting a brief: "We're aware of transient errors due to a bad deploy; we've rolled back and disabled the feature. We'll follow up with postmortem." will update in 15m.

ci-cd-bot: Canary termination event recorded, automated rollback triggered at 2468136030.

sre-bot: Note: evidence of digest mismatch in deployment metadata. saving audit trail.

alex: good work. next steps: - leave registry ACL in place until we confirm immutability - run a registry consistency scan for tags pushed in last 24h - identify the CI job that pushed the mutable tag and add immutability step to pipeline - assign postmortem owner

jasper: i'll own the postmortem. provisional owner: jasper (REG-4567). I'll include timeline, root cause (mutable tag retag), customer impact, and remediation (tag immutability + CI change + admission control).

maria: quick ask: who will communicate to enterprise customers with higher SLA? olivia?

olivia-cs: yes, i'll escalate to Enterprise CS team with suggested language.

alex: oncall handoff: i'm going offline in ~10m - maria will take oncall lead from here. maria confirm?

maria: confirmed. i'm primary oncall until 0800 UTC. alex — safe handoff, leave any followups in REG-4567.

olivia-cs: customer note will go out after final confirmation, ETA ~20m.

jasper: closing immediate mitigation. postmortem will target tomorrow EOD. anything else urgent?

alex: nothing blocking. thanks team.

sre-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation at 2468136480. Follow-up tasks created: REG-4567, PMT-331.
